question: Explain whether our CCC problem is driven more by slow customers, excess inventory, or supplier payment timing.

```sql
SELECT
  'DSO (Days Sales Outstanding)' AS ccc_component,
  SUM(pa.days_to_pay * pa.amount_applied) / SUM(pa.amount_applied) AS component_days,

FROM mro_distributor.ar_payment_application pa
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'DIO (Days Inventory Outstanding)' AS ccc_component,
  (
    SELECT AVG(daily_value) FROM (
      SELECT snap.snapshot_date_key, SUM(snap.value_on_hand) AS daily_value
      FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot snap
      GROUP BY snap.snapshot_date_key
    )

    FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol
  ) AS component_days,
  'Inventory: capital tied up in stock' AS driver_description
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'DPO (Days Payable Outstanding)' AS ccc_component,
  SUM(bp.days_to_pay * bp.amount_paid) / SUM(bp.amount_paid) AS component_days,
  'Payables: time to pay suppliers' AS driver_description
FROM mro_distributor.p2p_bill_payment bp
```

question: Which suppliers are late but still being paid faster than average?

```sql
SELECT 
  s.supplier_name,

  AVG(po.late_days) AS avg_late_days,
```

question: Which item categories create the worst combination of high DIO and high stockout rate?

sql_generation.sql:
```sql
WITH dio_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dim_item.category,
    (SELECT AVG(daily_value) FROM (
      SELECT snap.snapshot_date_key, SUM(snap.value_on_hand) AS daily_value
      FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot snap
      GROUP BY snap.snapshot_date_key))
    /
    (SELECT SUM(sol.ext_cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT sol.order_date_key)
     FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol) AS dio_days,
    AVG(CASE WHEN snap.is_stockout THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS stockout_rate_pct
  FROM mro_distributor.inv_balance_snapshot snap
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_item ON snap.item_key = dim_item.item_key
  GROUP BY dim_item.category
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(dio_days, 2) AS dio_days,
  ROUND(stockout_rate_pct, 2) AS stockout_rate_pct,
  ROUND(dio_days * stockout_rate_pct, 2) AS combined_score
FROM dio_by_category
ORDER BY combined_score DESC;
```

question: Which suppliers indirectly delay customer cash collection through late receipts and delayed fulfillment?

```sql
WITH item_supplier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT po.item_key, po.supplier_key
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po
),
p2p AS (
  SELECT s.supplier_key, s.supplier_name, s.reliability_tier, AVG(po.late_days) AS avg_late_days
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_supplier s USING (supplier_key)
  GROUP BY s.supplier_key, s.supplier_name, s.reliability_tier
),
o2c AS (
  SELECT s.supplier_key, AVG(ff.order_to_ship_days) AS avg_order_to_ship_days

  JOIN item_supplier m USING (item_key)

  GROUP BY s.supplier_key
)

  p2p.reliability_tier,

  o2c.avg_order_to_ship_days
```

WITH item_supplier AS (

po_metrics AS (

  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po

),
stockout_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    m.item_key,
    AVG(CASE WHEN snap.is_stockout THEN 100.0 ELSE 0 END) AS stockout_pct

  JOIN item_supplier m USING (item_key)

),
otif_metrics AS (

    COUNT(CASE WHEN ff.ship_date_key IS NOT NULL
               AND ff.ship_date_key <= sol.promised_ship_date_key

    / COUNT(*) AS otif_pct

label: d040-baseline-3
question: Compare fast-moving versus slow-moving items: which group suffers more from supplier lateness?

sql_generation.sql:
WITH velocity AS (
  SELECT ff.item_key, SUM(ff.qty_shipped) AS units
  FROM mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff
  GROUP BY ff.item_key
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT quantile_cont(units, 0.2) AS q FROM velocity
),
item_supplier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT po.item_key, po.supplier_key
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po
),
fast_movers AS (
  SELECT 'Fast-Moving' AS group_type,
         AVG(po.late_days) AS avg_late_days,
         COUNT(*) AS po_count
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po
  JOIN item_supplier m USING (item_key)
  JOIN velocity v USING (item_key)
  WHERE v.units > (SELECT q FROM cutoff)
),
slow_movers AS (
  SELECT 'Slow-Moving' AS group_type,
         AVG(po.late_days) AS avg_late_days,
         COUNT(*) AS po_count
  FROM mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po
  JOIN item_supplier m USING (item_key)
  JOIN velocity v USING (item_key)
  WHERE v.units <= (SELECT q FROM cutoff)
)
SELECT * FROM fast_movers
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM slow_movers
ORDER BY avg_late_days DESC;

label: d040-baseline-3
question: Break down our OTIF misses: what share is late-only, short-only, or both, and which suppliers sit behind the late portion?

sql_generation.sql:
```sql
WITH otif_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    sol.so_line_key,
    sol.qty_ordered,
    ff.qty_shipped,
    ff.ship_date_key,
    sol.promised_ship_date_key,
    CASE WHEN ff.ship_date_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS never_shipped,
    CASE WHEN ff.ship_date_key IS NOT NULL AND ff.ship_date_key > sol.promised_ship_date_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_late,
    CASE WHEN ff.qty_shipped IS NOT NULL AND ff.qty_shipped < sol.qty_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_short,
    CASE WHEN ff.ship_date_key IS NOT NULL 
          AND ff.ship_date_key <= sol.promised_ship_date_key 
          AND ff.qty_shipped >= sol.qty_ordered THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_otif
  FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol
  LEFT JOIN mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff USING (so_line_key)
),
miss_categories AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
      WHEN is_otif = 1 THEN 'OTIF'
      WHEN never_shipped = 1 THEN 'Never Shipped'
      WHEN is_late = 1 AND is_short = 1 THEN 'Both Late & Short'
      WHEN is_late = 1 THEN 'Late Only'
      WHEN is_short = 1 THEN 'Short Only'
    END AS miss_category,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count
  FROM otif_analysis
  WHERE is_otif = 0
  GROUP BY miss_category
),
late_suppliers AS (
  SELECT
    s.supplier_name,
    s.reliability_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS late_po_lines
  FROM mro_distributor.o2c_sales_order_line sol
  LEFT JOIN mro_distributor.o2c_fulfillment_line ff USING (so_line_key)
  JOIN mro_distributor.p2p_purchase_order_line po ON ff.item_key = po.item_key
  JOIN mro_distributor.dim_supplier s USING (supplier_key)
  WHERE ff.ship_date_key IS NOT NULL 
    AND ff.ship_date_key > sol.promised_ship_date_key
  GROUP BY s.supplier_name, s.reliability_tier
  ORDER BY late_po_lines DESC
)
SELECT
  mc.miss_category,
  mc.line_count,
  ROUND(mc.line_count * 100.0 / SUM(mc.line_count) OVER (), 1) AS pct_of_misses,
  NULL AS supplier_name,
  NULL AS reliability_tier,
  NULL AS late_po_lines
FROM miss_categories
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Late suppliers' AS miss_category,
  NULL AS line_count,
  NULL AS pct_of_misses,
  ls.supplier_name,
  ls.reliability_tier,
  ls.late_po_lines
FROM late_suppliers
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN miss_category = 'Late suppliers' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  CASE WHEN miss_category != 'Late suppliers' THEN CAST(pct_of_misses AS NUMERIC) ELSE NULL END DESC,
  late_po_lines DESC;
```
